symbols.name: DevAppInstanceDatabaseAdapterBase
symbols.summary: Base class of the database adapters that give each linked worktree its own database <database>_wNN.
symbols.remarks: Discovery looks at every configuration key whose path contains ConnectionString. A key is claimed when its value parses as a connection string of the provider and names a database. Keys that point at the same server and database form one resource, so they all get the same instance database. Only the database name changes. Credentials and every other option are kept and never logged.

syntax.content: public abstract class DevAppInstanceDatabaseAdapterBase : IDevAppInstanceDatabaseAdapter, IDevAppInstanceResourceAdapter
